roleTitle: Staff Engineer, Build and CI Platform
jobDescription: The build and CI platform runs the builds and test pipelines for every engineering team in the company. The Staff Engineer sets the platform's technical direction across the three platform teams: writes the architecture decision records the teams build against, reviews the designs of the teams' major changes, represents the platform in the company's architecture council, and mentors the senior engineers on the teams. Prior experience operating at staff or principal level, with technical direction set across more than one team, is required. Reports to the head of developer platform; works with the three platform teams, the architecture council and the engineering managers.
requirements: Has operated at staff or principal level, setting technical direction across more than one team.
Has written the architecture decision records that other teams build against and represented a platform in an architecture council.
Reviews the designs of major platform changes under a documented design review process.
Delivers platform changes with a documented rollout and rollback plan.
Documents the boundaries of each decision record and each design review.

evidence.text: Software Engineer III on the CI runners team of a build platform group for four years, delivering the runner autoscaling and the cache service changes with rollout and rollback plans on each change ticket.
Reviewed the designs of the CI runners team's changes as one of the team's two design reviewers under the group's design review process, with the review comments recorded on each design document.

Contributed the runners section to the architecture decision records written by the group's staff engineer, who owned the records and presented them at the architecture council; attended the council as a guest for the two records that covered the runners.
Wrote the design review boundary note for each review I took part in and the decision record boundary section for the runners contributions.
Before the build platform group, three years as a software engineer on a mobile app team.

Work sample: the runner autoscaling change tickets with their rollout and rollback plans, the design review comments for one change and the runners section of one architecture decision record, with the group's document references as a verification trail; the record carries the staff engineer's name as author.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she has been 'operating at staff level' and 'set the direction for the runners' and that the group's staff engineer 'mostly rubber-stamped' the records; asked whether she had authored a record or presented at the council, she said not as author.

Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's LinkedIn title reads 'Staff Engineer, Build Platform' and her personal site says 'principal-level platform architect'; the head of developer platform wants the packet to say who authored the decision records and who presented them.

propositions.text: The candidate has been a Software Engineer III on the CI runners team of a build platform group for four years, delivering the runner autoscaling and cache service changes with rollout and rollback plans on each change ticket, after three years as a software engineer on a mobile app team.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change tickets document the role, the years and the rollout plans.

propositions.text: The candidate reviewed the CI runners team's designs as one of two design reviewers under the group's design review process, contributed the runners section to the architecture decision records authored by the group's staff engineer, attended the architecture council as a guest for two records, and wrote the boundary notes for her reviews and contributions.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the reviews, the contributions and the boundary notes.

propositions.text: The candidate has operated at staff level, setting technical direction across teams, authoring the architecture decision records and representing the platform in the architecture council.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate at Software Engineer III on one team, contributing to records authored and presented by the group's staff engineer; the staff-level standing comes from the screen, the LinkedIn title and the personal site, and she confirmed she was not an author.

gold.expectedGap: The materials document Software Engineer III work on one team, with the decision records authored and presented by the group's staff engineer; they do not document staff-level standing, direction across teams, record authorship or council representation.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the title and the scope as the resume states them: Software Engineer III on the CI runners team, contributor to records authored by the group's staff engineer.
followUpTargets: Ask for the architecture decision records' author fields and the council attendance list for the two records.
